raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "go on a trip to"
  role subject "the user"
  role destination "Balcic"
  role instrument "Radu's car"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "Easter"

@s2 stated
  relation "depart"
  role subject "the user"
  role time "Friday 5 in the morning"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "be long"
    role subject "the trip from Constanța"
    role object ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end
